{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, removing commas
# First, check for any non-numeric characters or anomalies
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion worked
test_sample = data['revenue_clean'].sample(5)
print(f'Converted revenue sample: {test_sample.values}')

# Check for QA orders — they are 999999.99 in the raw data
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'QA orders found after cleaning: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# Check completed orders
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
print(f'Completed orders: {completed_mask.sum()}')"}
